summary: SCMS iteration 2 full-stack testing. Backend: 53/53 pytest pass (32 iter1 regression + 21 new). New coverage: (1) NEW admin jagadishchandu789@gmail.com / Manasa@123 returns platform_admin and legacy platform@scms.com still works; (2) Twilio scaffolding verified — after absent-attendance bulk, /api/notifications shows channel='whatsapp', status='queued', delivery_note='twilio_not_configured'; (3) /api/calendar/events returns holiday+exam types, month=YYYY-MM filter works; (4) /api/audit returns list, grows after student create with action='create' resource='student' actor_role='school_admin', returns [] for teacher/parent; (5) /api/subscriptions/plans auto-seeds Starter/Growth/Enterprise on first call, /assign updates school.subscription, /usage/{school_id} returns school + usage; (6) /api/receipts/payment/{id}.pdf returns application/pdf + %PDF body for school_admin, 403 cross-school; (7) /api/receipts/student/STU-00001/report.pdf works for school_admin + own parent, 404 for other parent; (8) Photo upload accepts image/png + stores data URL, rejects text/plain with 400, parent can upload only for own child (403 otherwise); (9) RBAC + health regression all green. Frontend: NEW admin login navigates to /platform (schools list rendered), /platform/subscriptions shows all 3 plan cards (data-testid plan-starter/plan-growth/plan-enterprise), /platform/audit and /school/audit render (audit-log-page), /school/calendar renders calendar-page + cal-month='May 2026', logout works and redirects to /login, parent login → /parent shows child card with photo placeholder + 'Report PDF' button (parent-download-report) + Payment history section, mobile (390px) shows mobile-menu-toggle which opens mobile-drawer with mobile-drawer-close button.
action_items: (Cosmetic / seed-data) STU-00001 is seeded with paid=16000 directly on the fee doc but no corresponding doc in fee_payments collection, so the parent Payment history list is empty out-of-the-box. Pre-seeding 1-2 fee_payments rows for paid fees would make the 'pp-receipt-<id>' download buttons visible without the parent first triggering a /fees/payments POST.
(Cosmetic) New default admin's display name is still 'Platform Super Admin' — consider personalising to 'Jagadish' on the seed update path.
critical_code_review_comments: core/notify.py + WhatsApp: notifications are correctly persisted with channel='whatsapp', status='queued', delivery_note='twilio_not_configured' when TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID is empty. Send path is gated and safe; main agent should add structured logging when real send fails (status='failed') in future.

routes/audit.py: returns [] for non-admin roles (200), correct. core/audit.log_action invoked on student create, update, delete, upload_photo — good coverage. Consider also logging fee_payment creation and subscription assignment for full surface.

routes/subscriptions.py: list_plans lazy-seeds 3 defaults on first call (good for tests). /usage returns embedded school object including subscription nested doc; ensure _id is excluded — verified ({'_id':0} projection used).

routes/receipts.py: cross-school 403 enforced via user.school_id check; parent restricted via parent_user_id. Filename uses receipt_no; payments seeded inline avoid leaking other school data. Reportlab build is synchronous CPU-bound — under heavy load consider running in a threadpool.
routes/students.py upload_photo: 2MB cap + content-type allowlist verified. Stored as data URL — fine for MVP but will bloat documents; eventual S3/GridFS recommended for scale.
Seed_platform_admin is idempotent and password-refresh aware — verified by logging in with new password after upgrade.
Mobile drawer (Sidebar.jsx): testids mobile-menu-toggle/mobile-drawer/mobile-drawer-close all present and functional at 390x844.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke (new+legacy admin, school admin, parent, mobile drawer, all required data-testids)

rca of the issue: No bugs found. Only a soft observation: parent payment-history is empty out-of-the-box because seed assigns fees.paid=16000 without inserting matching fee_payments docs; this hides the pp-receipt-<id> buttons until the school admin posts a /fees/payments record. Trivial fix in seed_demo_data if desired.
